# Github Launch Studio

Prepare a cohesive GitHub launch with positioning, a README, demos and release copy.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Plan and produce launch-ready GitHub open-source projects—positioning, README, demo assets, release notes, and bilingual announcement copy—for first launches, major releases, or growth-focused repository makeovers.

Example request:

> Use github-launch-studio to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill github-launch-studio
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/github-launch-studio/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/github-launch-studio/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
